label: City of Vergennes
header:
# City of Vergennes municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 4 elects a Mayor to a two-year term

City of Vergennes, City Council page (vergennes.org): styles Chris Bearor as Mayor; he was elected in March 2025 to a two-year term. The certified justices of the peace listing gives his full form as Christopher Bearor
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 4 elects six aldermen, three elected annually to two-year terms
City of Vergennes, City Council page: lists Dickie Austin (Senior Alderman and Deputy Mayor), Michael Daniels, James Dragon, Melvin Hawley, Mark Koenig, and Jill Murray-Killon

City of Vergennes, City Council minutes of April 14, 2026: James Dragon was appointed (4-2) to the alderman seat resigned by Carson Harder-Hyde on March 6, 2026, for a term to March 2027; Dickie Austin, Michael Daniels, Melvin Hawley, and Jill Murray-Killon won election in March 2026, and Mark Koenig's term runs to 2027
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 9: the City Council appoints the City Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Betsy Sullivan as Vergennes' City Clerk (the Guide does not mark the charter appointment)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 9: the City Council appoints the City Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Betsy Sullivan as Vergennes' City Treasurer
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 4 elects one lister at a time to staggered three-year terms
City of Vergennes, 2026 Annual Report, table of city officials as of December 31, 2025 (report page 46): lists William Benton as the elected lister with a term to 2027

City of Vergennes, City Council minutes of April 14, 2026: the March 2026 election left both warned lister seats unfilled and the Council reappointed incumbents Danelle Birong and Sarah Cowan (the signed minutes' spelling governs over the report table's 'Cowen')
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 15 (City of Vergennes): section 4 elects one Auditor at a time to staggered three-year terms

City of Vergennes, 2026 Annual Report, table of city officials as of December 31, 2025 (report page 46): the December 2025 holders (David Austin, Chris LaPierre, Jennifer Clark) were themselves appointees with terms ending March 2026; the 2026 election warned three-year, two-year, and one-year auditor seats but no winners are published, so the post is created without memberships
